question:
What creates the Earth’s magnetic field (and why does it move)?
Earth’s liquid-metal outer core creates electric currents. The planet’s rotation causes these currents to form a dynamic magnetic field. The currents and changes in the ionosphere influence the movement of the magnetic field.
